input: Final chronological groups, optional repair v2, first/middle/last up to 3 recorded triptychs per group, 960px atlas width. All groups provided in one global call; no region labels, simulator poses/actions or target region count.
guard: Every group exactly once. Actual representative references only. Each core group needs at least one non-boundary citation; missing citations quarantine only that group as unknown, preserving raw protocol failure. Other schema errors or entire-region citation failure stop execution.
inheritance: Unshown observations inherit source-group core membership provisionally; not individual VLM verification.
evaluation: Fixed core queries; predicted core boundaries count as unknown and remain in denominator. Boundary precision/recall scored separately. Coarse open-living granularity and original fine labels remain separate.
scope: Research offline baseline only, not default production pipeline, navigation authority or held-out hardware acceptance. Prompt changes require new hash and archived run; group sampling/interface changes require a new protocol. Existing test.3 tag unchanged.
